plan: My value is $23. The optimal strategy in a second-price auction is to bid your true value. This strategy is dominant, meaning it maximizes my profit regardless of what other bidders do. I will bid $23.

My goal is to maximize long-term profit. Given this is a single round and my value is $18, I need to decide on a bid. In a second-price auction, bidding your true value is often a dominant strategy.
